book.name: Aposel
book.title: Aposel heki’walaŋ kwanai diniŋ kahat Lukdi youkuk

content: Pita dut Jon mede gineŋ yapmegiŋ

Pita dut Jon adi metam Jesudi kumuŋ gineniŋ kaikaaŋ pilakuk undugoŋ kougoŋ metam kumuŋa pilatneeŋ unduŋ hayenilune Siloŋyot diniŋ talitimeŋ heki eŋ mikme Siloŋyot kadoko tagiŋ heki tiŋa Sadusi heki adi buŋa Pita yakat hakumukneŋ busuwaaŋ mede u nadiune tuwot mu tuguk.
Kaŋ yohonegiŋ, iŋgoŋ tebele tuguk doktiŋa yanagi wooŋ yot fafaŋeniŋneŋ yapmeune uŋgoŋ ilu heleyemguk.
U tiyemgiŋ nai uŋaniŋ metam feedi medehik nadiŋa nadisukilitigiŋ kaŋ kunakunathik adi 5 tausen tuguk.
Yot fafaŋeniŋneŋ ilu heleyembune Judame heki’walaŋ talitimeŋ, me wapuhi eŋ Yodoko Mede hinale heki
adi Jelusalem uŋgoŋ Siloŋyot diniŋ Talitimeŋ Wapum Anas, eŋ Kaifa, eŋ Jon Alesanda, tiŋa Anas’walaŋ mihiŋiye noli noŋgoŋ bopneŋ
Aposel yakat yenimbune wooŋ namandahik gineŋ yalune kisaŋgoŋ hinek indiŋ yeninadigiŋ, “Neeŋdi behik tihambune kudi i tugumuk? Maŋgoŋ saŋiniŋ be neeŋ wou foloŋ kudi u tugumuk? Mu yoyamuk!”
Unduŋ yeninadilu Uŋgoniŋ Munabulidi Pita weleŋ maaneŋ fotokoune yeniŋguk, “Me wapuhiniye,
indi me kayoŋ kadakaniŋ u dediŋ timinde kedebaguk wondok nininadiiŋ doktiŋa indiŋ nadineŋ.
Isilaehi metam hogohogok hidi, me kayoŋ kadakaniŋ i Jesu Kilisto Nasaletniŋ, hide ulukumuŋgiŋ kaŋ Bepaŋdi kumuŋ gineniŋ tubupilakuk, adi’walaŋ saŋiniŋŋiŋ gineŋ utumbaguk.
Jesu Kilistodegoŋ Youkudip Mededi indiŋ yolak,

content.text: ‘Yot taka niŋ me yot mamaŋ tiiŋdi hogoli yo

content: Hatihati fafaŋeniŋ diniŋ talik u adigoŋ. Kwet foloŋ iŋoŋ Bepaŋdi nebek noli nemu niŋguk, moŋ hinek.”

Unduŋ yenimbune me wapuhi adi meyat u me-fit, adi nadinadi yot wapumneŋ mu fogumuk iŋgoŋ dediŋ tiŋa mede muntanit mokit mahik loŋgoŋ yoyamuk yo yabunadiune uŋgoniŋ hinek tuguk. Iŋgoŋ kougoŋ Jesu keleyaugumuk u naditomgiŋ.
Unduŋ tiŋa me kayoŋ kadakaniŋ utumbaguk adi maaŋ noŋgoŋ yakiŋ doktiŋa mede lohi tiŋa
wabi yeniŋkulune fougiŋ. Kaŋ me wapuhi nehi uŋgoŋ hali
maŋgoŋ hinek tiyemdok yoŋa yonadi tigiŋ. Tiŋa indiŋ yogiŋ, “Metam hogohogok Jelusalem maaneŋ itowiiŋ adi kudi uŋgoniŋ tugumuk u agaŋ mintaune kaŋ nadidapmaiŋneŋ, indi yalaŋ tuwot mu yeninim.
Unduŋ doktiŋa gigit yendi kwetkwet mu hautadok nadiŋa meyat yeninene Jesu wou kotigoŋ mu yoyademeek.”
Unduŋ yoŋa Pita yakat kotigoŋ yenimbu loune Jesu wou kotigoŋ mu yoyaudok yo moŋ hinek yenihegiŋ.
Unduŋ yeniŋgiŋ kaŋ Pita dut Jondibo mede indiŋ tubu-udaneyemgumuk, “Hidi hide nadineŋ. Indi Bepaŋ’walaŋ medeŋiŋ bikabuŋa hidi’walaŋ mede tagimnede Bepaŋdi nadiu utumbawek be?
Unduŋ doktiŋa indi nemek inde kaŋ nadigumut u wabidimdok tuwot moŋ.”

Unduŋ yeniŋgumuk kaŋ me wapuhi adi kadakaniŋhik nemu tubumintagiŋ doktiŋa kotigoŋ yenihep fafaŋeniŋgoŋ tiŋa yeniŋkulu fo ugumuk. Me wapuhi adi widihi titiŋdok iŋgoŋ metam feedi nemek u mintagukdok Bepaŋ niutumbagiŋ doktiŋa wabigiŋ.
Me kayoŋ kadakaniŋ utumba tuguk adi me kilitiniŋ. Gulet 40 agaŋ kalakapme tuguk.
Metam nadisukilitihinit adi nemenemek titiŋdok welekubugoŋ tiŋa tiyagiŋ
Pita dut Jon yeniŋkulu fakaŋ fooŋ wooŋ me noli yehibopneeŋ me wapuhidi mede yeniŋgiŋ hogohogok u yenimbu
nadiŋa nadinadihik kiulaŋa Bepaŋ indiŋ ninadigiŋ, “O Wapumnik, Saŋiniŋ Molom, du nemenemek kwetfoloŋ be kunum gineŋ be imeŋgwaŋ wapum gineŋ yobune mintaguk hatak.
Du koom Uŋgoniŋ Munabulidi papanik Dewit da’walaŋ kwanai-mege mede niŋ indiŋ nimbu yoguk,

content.text: ‘Me Judahi’walaŋ feknit mokit heki Judahi’walaŋ Yodoko Mede mu nadiiŋ
adi maŋgoŋde kwihita tiiŋ? Metam adi nadihebet hogohihogohi kabukabup maŋgoŋde tiiŋ?
Kwetfoloŋ iŋoŋ mapme heki eŋ me kwet kaulidoko tiiŋ adi kikasop tiŋa Bepaŋ dut Kilistoŋiŋ aditok mik tiyemne bop molomgoŋ tiiŋ.’

content: O Bepaŋ, koom undugoŋ Helot dut Pailat adi me Judahi’walaŋ feknit mokit eŋ Judame heki iŋgoŋ hatiiŋ adigut bopneeŋ Jesu Kilisto, tipilapilaye-mege uŋgoniŋ u mik timiŋgiŋ.
Adi bopneeŋ da yodapmaguŋ wondok tuwot tigiŋ.
Ale Wapum, du kamiŋ folofigita be kwanai nimne tiiŋ u yabunadiŋa kwanai-megeye indi ninindapmaune medege muntamuntanit mokit yohautanim.
Kaŋ da kohoge kihiwali tutumba kwanai be kudi mebimebi u tipilapilaye-mege uŋgoniŋ, Jesu, adi wou foloŋ tubune mintatauluwaak.”
Bepaŋ unduŋ ninadidapmaune yot bopneeŋ hali ninadigiŋ u ti mahamut tuguk kaŋ Uŋgoniŋ Munabulidi fotokiyembune Bepaŋ medeŋiŋ muntanit mokit mahik loŋgoŋ yogiŋ.
Metam nadisukilitihinitdi welekubugoŋ tiŋa hatiŋa nebek niŋdi nemek niŋ u ne’walaŋ hogok mu yoluguk. Bomboŋhik hogohogok u kubugoŋ ilune moŋgola hatiyagiŋ.
Bepaŋdi kahaŋ momooŋ tiyemilune Aposel heki adi Wapum Jesu’walaŋ pilapilatŋiŋ diniŋ mede saŋiniŋnit yoyagiŋ.
Metam kwethinit be yothinit adi meeniŋdok yembu tuwaune muneeŋ moŋgo buune Aposel hekidi dane tagiŋ, doktiŋa nebek niŋ nemek niŋdok baniŋ tiŋa lohilohi nemu tuguk.
Ala me niŋ wou Josep adi Lewi yalakiŋiŋ, Saipalas uŋoŋ mintaguk kaŋ Aposel hekidi wou kobuli Banabas niyagiŋ (mebi, wele tubukiliti me).
Adi kwet faki niŋ diniŋ molom ala tuwadok yobu tuwaune muneeŋ u Aposel hekidok yemguk.
